label: Healthcare Full-Stack / FHIR Developer
summary: Healthcare Full-Stack Developer with 8+ years in software development and focused experience delivering FHIR-based consent, interoperability, and clinical workflow solutions. Hands-on with FHIR R4/R5, SMART on FHIR, CDS Hooks, FSH, SUSHI, Medplum, OpenMRS, OAuth2, React, Next.js, Node.js, and AWS. Experienced in turning healthcare standards into usable applications, reusable profiles, integration services, and secure cloud deployments.

bullets.text: Led development and deployment of FHIR integration environments connecting sandbox EHR systems, privacy services, CDS components, and consent workflows.
Implemented a Medplum-based SMART on FHIR application demonstrating consent-aware EHR-to-EHR interoperability with OAuth2 and Fly.io.
Architected an OpenMRS integration using Spring Boot, Apache Camel, Debezium, and FHIR transformation to deliver clinical events to a shared service.
Authored FHIR R5 profiles and value sets with FSH and SUSHI for research consent, ResearchStudy, and ResearchSubject workflows.
Developed Next.js and LHC-Forms interfaces for capturing, displaying, and managing digital consent and questionnaire responses.
Co-authored academic publications on FHIR-based pediatric consent modeling and research study enrollment.
Built production React applications and GraphQL integrations, strengthening reusable UI and deployment practices later applied to healthcare products.
Built a production FHIR-compatible consent management platform with patient and administrator portals using React, Redux, Node.js, GraphQL, and AWS.
Implemented secure authentication and event-driven backend capabilities with Cognito, AppSync, Lambda, DynamoDB, SNS, and EventBridge.
Delivered full-stack applications and administration tools using modern JavaScript, GraphQL, and cloud APIs.
Built reusable JavaScript integrations and documentation for complex third-party application workflows.
